questions.q: What is the Spanish word for zero?
questions.explanation: Cero means zero, the starting point for every count.

questions.q: 16, 17, 18, and 19 are built by gluing which two pieces together?
questions.explanation: Dieciséis, diecisiete, dieciocho, and diecinueve are all diez + y + a digit fused into one word.

questions.q: Which number is a completely fresh new word, with no gluing at all?
questions.explanation: Treinta (30) stands on its own, just like diez and veinte did.

questions.q: What does más mean in a Spanish math fact like 'dos más tres son cinco'?

questions.explanation: Veinticinco is one of the week's landmark numbers — 25.

questions.q: You want to ask how many classmates are buying lunch. What do you say?
questions.explanation: ¿Cuántos van a comprar el almuerzo? asks how many are buying lunch.
